description.narrative: UNDP has been assisting the Government of Tajikistan to adopt policies and laws aimed at enhancing the role of women in Tajik society. UNDP has also been a partner for both the government and the civil society in building services for women and girls. This project will build on the lessons and experience of previous interventions and will work to prevent gender-based violence (GBV) and discrimination against women and girls in Tajikistan. The project will focus on enhancing the capacity of duty bearers and stakeholders to prevent GBV, mitigate its impact on victims and survivors and enforce the human rights of GBV survivors, thus improving gender equality in the country and enhancing inclusive economic growth and peaceful and democratic governance. Gender-based violence is a multifaceted challenge that involves several sectors, including social welfare, public health, governance, justice as well as human rights. It also requires interventions at multiple levels – policy/legislative changes, raising awareness
